name: tartaria-desktop
description: Electron + Steam desktop wrapper for Tartaria Realms. Loads the Expo web export (react-native-web) and adds Steamworks (achievements/overlay). Separate npm package from the mobile app so it never affects the RN build.

scripts._comment: From repo root: `npx expo export --platform web` produces dist/. Copy/symlink it to desktop/web-build, then run these.

comment_optionalDependencies: Steam is optional so a failed steamworks.js install never blocks the FIRST playable .exe; main.js guards its require. Promote to a hard dependency once achievements are wired.
comment_build: ⚠⚠ OTA-1387 — ALL THREE TARGETS ARE REAL HERE. This wrapper lived on three separate branches (steam_Dev, linux_dev, mac_dev) and each pinned ITS OWN platform to a real target while stubbing the other two to 'dir'. Nothing needed that: the workflows pass --win/--linux/--mac on the electron-builder command line, which selects the target anyway. Under one trunk the stubs would just be three ways to build the wrong thing, so all three say what they actually produce.
